content: ईर् €2 <ab>Ā.</ab> (इर्ते, ईराञ्चके, ऐरिष्ट, ईरितुम्, ईर्ण) ; also €1 <ab>P.</ab> ({%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} ईरित) .²1 To go, move, shake (<ab>trans.</ab> also). .²2 To rise, arise or spring from. .²3 To go away, retire. .²4 To agitate, elevate; raise oneʼs voice. €10 <ab>U.</ab> or {%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (ईरयति, ईरित) .²1 To agitate, throw, cast; <ls>Śi. 8. 39</ls>; discharge, dart, hurl; ऐरिरच्च महाद्रुमम् <ls>Bk. 15. 52</ls>; <ls>R. 15. 20</ls>. .²2 To excite, prompt, urge; क्षेमंकरेऽर्थे मुहुरीर्यमाणः <ls>Bk. 12. 6</ls>. .²3 To cause to rise, produce. .²4 To utter, pronounce, proclaim, say, repeat; <ls>Māl. 1. 25</ls>; इतीरयन्तीव तया निरैक्षि <ls>N. 14. 21</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 69</ls>; <ls>Ki. 1. 26</ls>; <ls>R. 9. 8</ls>; निबोध चेमां गिरमीरितां मया. .²5 To cause to go, set in motion, move, shake; वातेरितपल्लवाङ्गुलिभिः <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; अपरागसमीरणेरितः <ls>Ki. 2. 50</ls>; <ls>Śi. 8. 20</ls>. .²6 To draw towards, attract; उद्धतैरिव परस्परसङ्गादीरितान्युभयतः कुचकुम्भैः <ls>Śi. 10. 32</ls>. .²7 To employ, use. .²8 To bring to life, revive. .²9 To elevate. --To raise oneself (<ab>Ā.</ab>).
